about: Attorney Stephen T. LaBriola is the founding partner of the Fellows LaBriola LLP law firm in Atlanta, Georgia. Serving a diverse range of clients throughout the greater Atlanta metro area and all across the state, Mr. LaBriola provides exceptional advocacy and support to those who have legal needs involving any of the following:

A summa cum laude graduate from the University of Colorado, Mr. LaBriola obtained his Juris Doctor from NYU School of Law in 1985. After law school, he served as a law clerk to two justices of the Colorado Supreme Court before serving as a Deputy District Attorney in Denver. Since 1993, Mr. LaBriola has achieved notable success in private practice, where he has focused the bulk of his practice on litigation.

At all turns, Mr. LaBriola delivers highly personalized counsel, and he has earned a reputation for his tenacity and for always aggressively pursuing the most favorable outcome possible for his clients. Recognized for his professionalism and service, he holds an AV Preeminent peer review rating* from Martindale-Hubbell as well as the designation of a "Legal Elite" from Georgia Trend magazine each year since 2006. Moreover, Mr. LaBriola received the "Lawyer of the Year" award for Securities Litigation from Best Lawyers®.

Widely regarded as a leader in his field, Mr. LaBriola has served as president of The Cooper Inn of Court. He also served as chair of the Atlanta Bar Association's Litigation section, and he served on the subcommittee on Advertising of the American Bar Association's Committee of Professionalism and Ethics. Furthermore, he has conducted numerous continuing legal education seminars across his region.
